== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Reitzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Finals (4th)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Throne Room Mains
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH TRM Reitzel LS 1996 Worlds.txt |Download]]

Reitzel published these as the 60-card Light deck he played at Vail. Spelling normalized to printed titles (Tatooine, not Tattooine).

The Vermithrax transcription of the Scrye list for Reitzel has only 55 cards and differs from the list Reitzel published: it has 4 Alter, 5 Corellian Corvette, 2 Dantooine, 2 Demotion, 2 Don't Get Cocky, 2 R2-D2, 1 Revolution and For Luck, and no Gift Of The Mentor, Leia Organa, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, Pops, Rebel Barrier, Tiree or Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room, with one Han Solo.<ref name="fb1996">Kevin Reitzel, Facebook post, 29 April 2026: [https://www.facebook.com/kevin.reitzel/posts/its-been-30-years-my-star-wars-ccg-1996-championship-deck-lists-that-i-used-at-t/10241711434940142/ "It's been 30 years…"] (his own 1996 Worlds lists, from the physical decks). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130834/https://swccg.com/snapshots/facebook/reitzel-1996-worlds-decklists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="verm">[https://vermsgameblog.blogspot.com/2013/04/star-wars-ccg-champion-decklists-from.html Star Wars CCG: 1996 Light Side Champion Decklists], Vermithrax's Game Blog (5 April 2013; Scrye magazine transcription). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150729042221/http://vermsgameblog.blogspot.com/2013/04/star-wars-ccg-champion-decklists-from.html Internet Archive]</ref>
